tierReasoning: One wrong gh --json field name in a read seam; the fix changes the field, pins the projections in a unit test and adds a signal-only degradation report. A revert fully undoes it; no state, no migration, no new authority.

causalAutopsy.notes: PR #1893 (2026-08-14, mergerunner-auto-arm-handoff Blocker 4) widened refetchPr with the field name mergeCommitOid, which gh PR JSON never had (the field is mergeCommit {oid}). The view call has exited 1 (Unknown JSON field) ever since, and the seam read that as a vanished PR, so the watcher never armed anything on the act-time read. Latent until 2026-10-24, when PR #2334 sat green and unmerged and the audit showed skipped:vanished for every PR.
